```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The administration sought to link normal trade relations with China to human rights performance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration then reversed course and dropped the linkage between normal trade relations with China and human rights performance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration tried to bring China into the World Trade Organization during the Prime Minister of China's visit to the United States in 1999.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration reversed course again regarding bringing China into the World Trade Organization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration turned to Republican leadership in the Congress to enact permanent normal trade relations with China.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration refused to fight for passage of the Caribbean Basin Initiative, which was designed to extend the benefits of free trade to some of America's poorest neighbors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congressional Republicans enacted the Caribbean Basin Initiative.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congressional Republicans enacted the Africa Growth and Opportunity Act as a companion to the Caribbean Basin Initiative.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The administration's leadership in international economics is exemplified by the humiliating debacle of the WTO meeting in Seattle.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The administration first sponsored the WTO meeting in Seattle.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The administration then wrecked the WTO meeting in Seattle through its own indecision and inconsistency.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
